abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. It was also DURING_TURN with turn:'second', an invented parameter DURING_TURN does not read. 'Your SECOND attack this turn' is an ordinal, and the card is in the graveyard by the time that attack happens -- so it is a turn-scoped continuous effect gated on the ordinal, not a static on a card that is no longer anywhere.

_comment: The counter effect named a target and the compiler read none of it, so the counter went on the source card. Treasure Island is a named permanent, so the target matches it by name in the controller's arena. The gold-counter half was also typed ACTIVATE, which would need the card activated in the arena -- it is an action card that resolves and goes to the graveyard. It is a PLAY effect, and 'you may' makes it optional.
